name: Azure Application Gateway
short_description: Layer 7 web traffic load balancer in Azure that understands HTTP and HTTPS, routes requests by web rules and can handle TLS termination before traffic reaches back-end servers.

evidence.quote: Azure Application Gateway fits that type of job because it understands web traffic, including HTTP and HTTPs.
Azure Application Gateway does. And that single habit changes where your traffic lands.
The two that matter for most people are Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door.
Azure load balancer or application gateway
